title: Arc Raiders’ Big Update Has It Surging To Numbers It Hasn’t Seen In Months
text:
When Embark said it would take several months to deliver the major Arc Raiders update it envisioned, days like today were probably the goal. The extraction shooter is once again high up in Steam's charts for both best-selling and most-played games.
Among best sellers, Arc Raiders currently ranks fifth, behind this week's other big releases, Star Wars: Galactic Racer and Gears of War: E-Day, but those came out earlier this week, and it's still early, so we may see it leap over those before the week is through. Its new cosmetic DLC, the Frozen Trail Collector's Set, is also selling very well. It currently sits at #8 on the best-sellers list.
As for concurrent players, Arc Raiders has eclipsed triple digits on Steam, something it hasn't done since May. It's sitting at 106,000--that's good for 12th on the list--and has actually gained 5,000 more players since I started writing this. Like its sales surge, it seems likely that it'll keep climbing throughout the day.
Not coincidentally, May was when Embark announced it would be moving to a semi-annual cadence for major updates , with today's Frozen Trail being the first such update since that change. Embark felt it needed more time to deliver bigger updates for players while giving developers breathing room for a healthier work environment.
I've been fascinated by that bold move because it's rarely seen in the world of extremely popular live-service games. Arc Raiders never really dropped off completely; it still averaged 40,000 concurrent Steam players in September, but it was close to averaging half a million last holiday season, so the fall was precipitous, even if those numbers were likely never to be sustained.
The first day post-update can't tell the whole story on whether this revised roadmap pays off for Embark, but it's clearly off to a strong start.
Arc Raiders will be free-to-play this weekend on all of its available platforms.

title: Strange Scaffold Saved This New Tactics Game From Cancellation
text:
One of the more interesting game reveals from today's Triple-i Initiative showcase was Gods With Badges, a narrative-driven tactics game about a disgraced police officer returning to the line of duty. What makes Gods With Badges even more fascinating is that it was canceled by its original developer and saved by El Paso, Elsewhere developer Strange Scaffold.
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=MXdR706AKPQ
The press release announcing Gods With Badges explained that the project began at Artificer, the Devolver Digital-owned studio behind games like Minos, Sumerian Six, and Showgunners . Originally called Hard Justice, the project ultimately didn't pan out and almost never saw the light of day.
Meanwhile, Strange Scaffold is spearheading an initative called Project Share, which encourages developers to share the original code for their games so other studios can riff on it. This previously helped enable the development of another Creepy Redneck Dinosaur Mansion game .
The press release explains that Gods with Badges took the work already completed by Artificer and reinterpreted it "through Strange Scaffold's distinctive creative lens." Studio Head Xalavier Nelson Jr. added that he is "deeply grateful to the original developers at Artificer for trusting us with their project, and can't wait for people to see what we've built on this complex, exciting foundation."
Nelson later said the team didn't use "un-cancelling" in its messaging, instead saying Strange Scaffold is "making our own game with a batch of materials they have shared with us."
Gods With Badges follows a disgraced police officer named Harrow McClellan as she patrols the dystopian city of Scarhelm. Each encounter starts with choice-driven conversations but can devolve into isometric, turn-based combat. Players can even turn off their bodycam to gain access to more combat abilities, though this will obviously affect how the narrative plays out.
I expect this game to tackle subjects like police brutality and the role of law enforcement in an increasingly dystopian world. Gods With Badges will be released on PC sometime in 2027.

title: GTA 6 Merch Revealed, Including T-Shirt With Alligator Wearing Sunglasses And Drinking A Cocktail
text:
Ahead of GTA 6 's release in November, Rockstar Games has announced an official merch collection for the game, and it includes some snazzy stuff like a t-shirt featuring an alligator wearing sunglasses and drinking a cocktail.
The alligator's name is Macca the Gator, and he's the star of a fictional in-universe TV show of the same name. Presumably we will learn more about this at some point, but I am certainly intrigued.
All the GTA 6 merch you can buy right now.
Available in the Rockstar Store, the collection includes t-shirts sporting that alligator design and numerous others, including the GTA 6 logo. There are also a collection of branded hats in black, pink, and blue, along with a GTA 6-branded Zippo lighter, canvas tote bags, and vinyl stickers, among other offerings.
Of note, Rockstar says its t-shirts should be machine washed cold, but not put in the dryer. Instead, you should hang them on a line, Rockstar says.
In addition to this merch, Rockstar partnered with the NBA's Miami Heat for a "Vice City Collection" of gear you can buy right now.
GTA 6 launches on November 19 for PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. The game will have a lot of great music in it, as well as podcasts, and famous radio hosts .

title: Cyberpunk 2077 Is Getting A Movie Adaptation At Call Of Duty Film Studio, Transformers Producer On Board
text:
Movie studio Paramount has announced that it's making a Cyberpunk 2077 movie, becoming just the latest upcoming game adaptation. The studio is also behind the Call of Duty movie that's set for release in 2028 .
Deadline reported that Lorenzo di Bonaventura, known for his work on the super-popular Transformers movie series, is attached to produce. CD Projekt Red is on board as well to produce, which might make fans happy to hear.
CD Projekt Red's Michał Nowakowski praised Paramount , saying the company shares the developer's ambitions.
"We're excited about Paramount as a future partner who shares our creative ambitions for the Cyberpunk franchise. We look forward to sharing more details at the appropriate time," he said.
Cyberpunk 2's associate game director, Paweł Sasko, said , "I’m beyond excited chooms."
Cyberpunk 2077 is headed to the big screen.
Not all Hollywood adaptations include their creators, as Larian has no involvement in the Baldur's Gate 3 TV show , while Naughty Dog dropped out of The Last of Us Season 3 on HBO , prompting fears about creative decisions.
Paramount has been in the news a lot lately following the company's acquisition of Warner Bros. Discovery and combination of the two companies. Going forward, the parent company will be called Skydance.
Presumably the Call of Duty and Cyberpunk 2077 movies are among those set for release in theaters, following Paramount's commitment to releasing at least 30 movies in theaters each year .
It is very early days for the Cyberpunk 2077 movie, and there is no word yet on who may direct or star in it, nor has Paramount given it a release date.
The game series, meanwhile, is expanding with a sequel, Cyberpunk 2 , which is in development now.
Cyberpunk 2077 had a well-documented disastrous launch in December 2020, but the Polish developer steadily supported, updated, and improved the game over the years. Many are calling it  one of the best comeback stories ever for a high-profile game.  Things culminated in the  Cyberpunk 2077 2.0 release in 2023 and the launch of the stellar Phantom Liberty expansion . The game has sold more than 40 million copies .

title: Ubisoft Shutting Down Rainbow Six Mobile After Less Than A Year
text:
Ubisoft has announced that Rainbow Six Mobile is shutting down, and it didn't have a very long life. The game soft-launched in 2023, but properly rolled out for everyone back in February 2026. It will shut down on January 16, 2027, so it will have been online for less than a year in its full state for everyone.
"'We are proud of the passion, creativity, and dedication our team has put into the game," Ubisoft said. "One of the greatest parts of this adventure has been getting to experience it alongside you. We've loved seeing the memes, videos, strategies, tournaments, impossible plays, and all the countless moments that happened because you were here."
The developers are going to move on to "other long-term strategic projects," but Ubisoft did not say what these may be. The studio will share more details on the game's final days in the coming weeks.
"We are truly grateful to everyone who has played our game," the developers said.
Rainbow Six Mobile pitched itself as a mobile version of the extremely popular Rainbow Six Siege, which continues to crush it more than a decade after release. The next Rainbow Six game is Rainbow Six Tactics, and it's coming next year.
It's been a bumpy year for Ubisoft, as the company created a new organizational structure by way of its partnership with Tencent. As part of this, Ubisoft enacted mass layoffs, closed studios, and cancelled games .

title: Ben Affleck Has Some Strong Opinions About Fortnite Skins And How Hard The Game Is For Him
text:
Have you ever wondered what two-time Oscar-winner Ben Affleck thinks about Fortnite skins, and the game generally? You can now rest easy, as the man himself has weighed in with some strong takes.
Appearing on the New Heights podcast with brothers Jason and Travis Kelce, Affleck said he's a big gamer, and is particularly fond of first-person shooter games, so when he tried Fortnite, he thought he'd hold his own. That wasn't the case, though. He said not only did he get wiped out immediately, but the 12-year-olds he was playing against made fun of him after taking him out.
Affleck said he got heated and shouted back at the kids: "I don't suck! I'm a grown man!"
https://twitter.com/yonann/status/2108191229884133646
Affleck also told a brief story about how his son wanted Fortnite skins for Christmas, and he was shocked to learn the specific skins his son wanted cost hundreds of dollars. "They ain't even real? Just to wear in the game? That's bullsh**," Affleck said.
Affleck is a big fan of the competitive shooter Valorant . In the movie Gone Girl, Affleck's character can be seen playing Battlefield 3 .
Affleck is not the only person who has some strong words for the state of Fortnite. Writing for GameSpot, Phil Owen recently talked about why Fortnite sucks this season.

title: Ghost Of Tsushima Anime Taps Star Wars: Visions Talent For Its 2028 Release
text:
The upcoming anime adaptation of Sony's Ghost of Tsushima just took another big step forward, with Crunchyroll revealing more details on the cast and crew attached to the project, as well as a 2028 release window.
While details are still light on what the story will be,  Hayate Inc . did confirm that actors Mayumi Saco and Shinya Fukumatsu will voice characters. Saco had previously voiced Tomoe in Ghost of Tsushima, a master archer and pupil of the renowned Sensei Ishikawa, while Fukumatsu lent his vocal talents to One-Punch Man, playing the martial arts master Bomb.
Official poster artowrk for the Ghost of Tsushima Legends anime.
For the crew working behind the scenes on this production, there's some big talent attached. Takanobu Mizuno (Star Wars: Visions "The Duel") will direct the anime, and it'll be produced at animation studio Kamikaze Douga (Batman: Ninja, Star Wars: Visions shorts). For the story, that's being handled by Gen Urobuchi (Psycho-Pass) and Renji Oki (Azur Lane). Rounding out key roles, there's also Keiji Inai as the anime's music composer, Yoshikazu Iwanami handles sound direction, and Gyousyou Suzuki brings their talent for calligraphy to the project.
As for the source material video games, Ghost of Tsushima first hit the scene in 2020 for the PS4, and was later upgraded for PS5.
Its sequel, Ghost of Yotei , launched in 2025 and also received a " Complete Edition " upgrade that adds the Echoes of Sekigahara expansion and bundles in the Legends multiplayer mode.
Anime adaptations of video games are on the rise, as multiple other projects are in various stages of development currently. From Software's Sekiro: Shadows Die Twice and Bloodborne are getting the anime treatment, and the world of Hideo Kojima's Death Stranding is expanding with an anime film and a separate anime series that's on its way to Disney+.

title: Charlie Cox Recorded 40 Hours Of Dialogue For A Sega Game He Can’t Name Yet
text:
Daredevil: Born Again actor Charlie Cox is starring in an upcoming video game, but it's not the first time he has lent his voice to one of these projects. At New York Comic-Con 2026, Cox revealed that he'd just finished recording his lines for a game that'll be published by Sega, but he didn't say which one. Hilariously, Cox mentioned that the game's crew was disappointed to find out he was English, not American.
"I did another one! It doesn’t have a name yet," Cox said to IGN . "I did a Sega one. I've done one since. It hasn't come out yet. It was fun to do. It's hard. It's a whole different job, man. I'm not sure what I'm allowed to say, but I showed up for it, and I met them for the first time, they asked me to do this game, and so I agreed to it. Then I had to do 40 hours or whatever it was, and I showed up for the first day, and I was like, 'Hi guys, nice to meet you! How are you?' And all of them went, ‘Oh, he’s English.’ They’d hoped, they'd wanted him to be American. But now I've got to do 40 hours of lines I've not prepared in an accent. Yeah, I think they thought I was American."
In a perfect universe, Cox is headlining Sonic Frontiers 2.
So what game did Cox sign up for? It's probably not a Sonic the Hedgehog game, but if the gig involved him recording dozens of hours of vocals, that would suggest a narrative-heavy title. Persona and Like a Dragon would fit that bill, but Cox may have signed up for a completely new project at Sega. Fans of the Daredevil actor last heard him in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 , where he played Gustav.
The game won critical acclaim after it launched last year, and Cox was pleasantly surprised at how popular it was. While Cox was nominated for Best Performance at The Game Awards last year, he said he didn't deserve the full credit  as the motion-capture for Gustav was performed by Maxence Cazorla. With Expedition 33 proving to be a critical darling, Cox said he was looking forward to playing it-- after he got a console for it .
His fellow Daredevil actor, Deborah Ann Woll , will also be popping up early next year in God of War Laufey on PS5.

title: “Video Games” Singer Can’t Wait To Play New Video Game GTA 6
text:
Rockstar Games recently announced GTA 6's in-game radio stations , and one of them is co-hosted by 11-time Grammy-nominated Lana Del Rey. The singer-songwriter had a connection to video games before this, as she recorded the song "Video Games" on her 2012 album Born to Die. Now, she's set to appear in the biggest video game ever, and she's pretty stoked about that.
Speaking to Rolling Stone , Del Rey said, "On so many different levels this is super special and a privilege. Can’t wait to get into the game and start playing.”
Lana Del Rey and Morgan Wallen co-host GTA 6's Back Country Radio.
She plays the character Delta Dawne, and is a co-host for the Back Country radio station alongside singer Morgan Wallen as MW. Del Rey's husband, Jeremy Dufrene, will lend his voice to the game's Back Country Radio station, too, as the character Mud Dog Mike.
Elsewhere, the GTA 6 in-game radio stations feature other real-world famous musicians like Bad Bunny, and Kerry King and Tom Arya of Slayer
Music has always been a big part of the GTA franchise, and that continues with GTA 6. In the new game, players can listen to music in their cars and digest podcasts while walking around in Vice City through headphones. For more, check out all of the songs in GTA 6 so far.
GTA 6 launches on November 19 for PS5 and Xbox Series X|S, so its release is right around the corner. Fans have been waiting a long time , as the game has been in development since 2015.

title: The EU Is Coming For Gaming’s Most Manipulative Monetization Tactics
text:
European consumer protection authorities have announced a series of "coordinated actions" aimed at 10 video companies, accusing several of the biggest names in the industry--like Activision Blizzard and Ubisoft--of "dark patterns" that are designed to put minors and individuals at risk of gaming addiction.
If you've ever purchased in-game currency, then you're probably aware of how one of these tactics works. For example, Destiny 2's in-game currency, Silver, comes in bundles of 500, 1,000, and 1,500 units, but buying a fancy new skin for a set of armor ornaments costs between 600 and 1,500 Silver. That way, you're forced to purchase extra Silver that you don't need, and you can exchange any remaining Silver back for cash, creating what is essentially a one-way exchange rate conversion. Destiny 2 isn't an outlier in this space, as multiple big games like Fortnite and Call of Duty all have their own currencies, available through exploitative bundle deals. The key takeaway is that the setup of these bundles ensures that you'll always be short a few digital bucks on the one item you really want.
One of the few games that is changing its approach to in-game currency is Fortnite, as starting October 14, players can purchase the exact amount of V-Bucks they need. This change will also roll out to Rocket League and Fall Guys across Xbox, Nintendo, PC, Android, iPhone, and the Fortnite web Item Shop, but for now, it won't be supported on PlayStation.
The European-wide enforcement says that it's focused on practices that obscure real-world spending in video games, such as the use of premium in-game currencies, selling virtual currencies in set quantities that rarely align with item prices and thus force players to overspend, and insufficient parental control mechanisms. Under the coordination of the European Commission, the goal is to promote transparency and fairness, as well as protect the rights of consumers and minors when playing video games.
Minecraft Minecoins are just one of many premium in-game currencies out there.
So far, the following companies have been targeted by the Italian Competition Authority-led actions:
Activision Blizzard
Crytek
InnoGames GmbH
King
Mojang
Plarium Europe S.à.r.l.
PLR Worldwide Sales Limited
Riot Games
Supercell
Ubisoft
Activision Blizzard remains the primary point of focus, with games like Diablo Immortal and Call of Duty being singled out, expanding on previous investigations carried out on those titles. Manipulative user interface design tactics and poor customer support have also been cited as areas of concern. "These practices make it difficult for gamers, particularly vulnerable consumers, such as minors and individuals at risk of gaming addiction, to understand and keep track of how much money they are spending," the EC press statement reads .
If successful, this action could set a new regulatory precedent with stricter oversight of monetization strategies in free-to-play and live-service games across all European markets. This follows a recent trend across the world, where consumer protection, UI design, and contract transparency has come under the spotlight. Several years ago, the Federal Trade Commission began an investigation into "roach motel" subscriptions in live-service games that only required a single click to sign up for season passes or recurring subscriptions, but canceling them required the digital equivalent of jumping through multiple hoops.
Meanwhile, Sony has claimed that it doesn’t mislead customers into purchasing digital licenses for games (instead of actual ownership of the product) as it moves closer towards its all-digital future , and it is also set to pay out nearly $8 million to PlayStation customers as part of a settlement regarding digital game prices.

title: Is The BioShock Movie Ever Going To Happen? Director Weighs In
text:
A movie adaptation of the popular game series BioShock has been in the works for a long time, and like a lot of film projects, it appears to be trapped in Development Hell. It remains to be seen how things will shake out with BioShock, but now its director has provided a positive-sounding update.
Francise Lawrence told GamesRadar that the team is "still working on a script," but he believes, "We're pretty close." He added: "I'm feeling really good about it."
Hollywood is littered with stories of filmmakers who are excited about projects, only to see them never materialize for countless reasons. That could happen for BioShock, too, but Lawrence is hopeful.
"Yeah, I would love to make it. I've been like dying to. I've been working at it. I've been trying," he said.
A BioShock movie has been in development for more than a decade now, with Pirates of the Caribbean director Gore Verbinski originally tapped to direct for a theatrical release. He pushed for a big-budget, R-rated version, and the studio reportedly balked after Zach Snyder's expensive Watchmen adaptation flopped .
Netflix announced in 2022 that it had taken over the BioShock movie project, but things didn't go to plan. There was a regime change at Netflix, and producer Roy Lee said this resulted in the BioShock movie getting scaled back to become a more “personal” film .
The BioShock movie was supposed to happen years ago, but Lawrence had a full plate with 2025's The Long Walk and this December's The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping. With that movie finished up, Lee said he thinks Lawrence could begin work on BioShock in 2027 , though he acknowledged that anything can happen in Hollywood and plans may change.
Blade Runner 2049’s Michael Green and Terminator: Dark Fate’s Justin Rhodes are working on the script. There is no word yet on a cast.
Intriguingly, Lee said BioShock rights-owner Take-Two is “very anxious to see the movie come out” because the plan is for it to “coincide with some of the potential new incarnations of the game.”
Lee did not name any specific games outright, but Take-Two recently reiterated that the long-in-development BioShock 4 will see the light of day … some day. A remake of the original BioShock was reportedly in development, but was canceled in 2025.
As for the in-development BioShock 4, Take-Two boss Strauss Zelnick recently said the game is not dead and will come out “without question.” He offered this assurance to fans in the wake of BioShock 4 undergoing a partial overhaul to improve on key areas. Developer Cloud Chamber also suffered layoffs, with studio head Kelley Gilmore departing and former Diablo boss Rod Fergusson taking over. Some may recall how Ferguson was called in years ago to be a “closer” for BioShock Infinite to help get the game out the door.

title: Is GTA 6 Coming To Switch 2? Ask Rockstar, Nintendo Says
text:
Rockstar's GTA 6 is the biggest game of 2026 and possibly ever, but it's not coming to Switch 2 ... or is it? Nintendo of America's new president, Devon Pritchard, was recently asked if GTA 6 is coming to Switch 2, and she didn't say yes or no. Instead, she said people should ask Rockstar and its owner, Take-Two.
“That’s going to be a conversation for Take-Two and Rockstar, but nothing to announce on my end at this time,” Pritchard told Variety .
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=klc0fQmAL6k
In May of 2025, a report from NateTheHate said Rockstar was conducting tests to see about bringing GTA 6 to Switch 2 . He clarified that this doesn't mean GTA 6 was planned for Switch 2, going on to say developers regularly conduct tests to see if their games are technically feasible on different platforms.
For now, GTA 6 is confirmed only for PS5 and Xbox Series X|S when it launches on November 19. History suggests that a PC edition will follow later, but this is not confirmed.
CEO Strauss Zelnick said the company could bring more games to Switch 2, but it's unknown if GTA 6 may be among them. He said Take-Two “would not necessarily bring every title to the platform,” but he noted there is a “great” opportunity to bring some of its older titles to Switch 2. He also said he is a “big believer” in the Switch 2.
While GTA 6 may not be coming to Switch 2, Rockstar released GTA: The Trilogy - The Definitive Edition on Switch in 2021, and it's playable on Switch 2 as well. Before this, Rockstar released GTA: Chinatown Wars for Nintendo DS. GTA 1 and GTA 2 also came to the Game Boy back in the day.

title: Street Fighter Was On Death’s Door, And Its Players Weren’t Getting Any Younger
text:
Street Fighter 5 launched in 2016 in rough shape, and if things hadn't changed, the classic fighting game franchise might have been dead and buried by 2026. That's according to Street Fighter 6 producer Shuhei Matsumoto and game director Takayuki Nakayama, who recently spoke about how Capcom's signature fighting game franchise was knocking on death's door at one point, before a turnaround strategy reenergized it for a new generation of digital fisticuffs.
Following Capcom veteran Yoshinoro Ono's exit from the company in 2020, Matsumoto and Nakayama started work on a new Street Fighter game that could appeal to both the existing--and aging--player base while attracting new blood to the series. "When the two of us were talking during Street Fighter 5, we realized that if we didn't do something about Street Fighter, the Street Fighter IP would probably die in 10 years. It was critical. So, we had to make it a game where people would get to know it all over again and play it again," Matsumoto said in an interview with Karin Ohira  (via  IGN ). "At that time, the player base for Street Fighter 5 was roughly 35 to 45 years old. In 10 years, these people will be 60. It’s difficult to sustain the franchise if we only rely on that group."
Matsumoto added that while Street Fighter was still recognizable as a franchise, that didn't mean people were engaging with it. If things didn't change, Matsumoto predicted that the IP "would likely die in 10 years."
https://youtu.be/y2DSNf_1TDw
The turning point came with Street Fighter 6, as the team approached its development as if it were a brand-new fighting game. By not relying on the legacy of Street Fighter, designing the Modern Control scheme to level the playing field, adding World Tour mode, and incorporating the fighting game community more closely into the project, Street Fighter 6 proved to be a hit when it was released in 2023.
Street Fighter 6 is also arguably the fighting game of the current decade. It still has a healthy audience, has expanded with post-launch content, and its modernized control schemes have attracted new players. It would have been a strange twist of fate if Street Fighter did fade into obscurity, as back in the late-2000s, Street Fighter 4 was credited with reinvigorating the fighting game scene, following several years of the genre being overshadowed by new game IP on the rise.
You could also point to Street Fighter 6 as another example of Capcom's golden touch: after the release of Resident Evil 7 almost a decade ago, the company has turned out hit after hit, with only a few misses along the way. This year alone has seen Capcom release four games, with each one being critically acclaimed-- Resident Evil: Requiem , Pragmata , Monster Hunter Stories 3 , and Onimusha: Way of the Sword .
Beyond that, Zach Cregger's Resident Evil movie adaptation has also been a big hit--and is one of the most commercially successful in the franchise --and it'll be followed by a new live-action Street Fighter movie later this month.

title: 《影之刃零》最终前瞻｜IGN中国
text:
可能是最具国际范儿的中国武侠游戏
就在上个月，灵游坊邀请我去他们公司体验了《影之刃零》的完整版。虽然这个版本离最终上市的版本还尚需进一步打磨和优化，但灵游坊毫不吝啬地让我足足玩了一整个下午，让我对整个游戏的开局阶段有了一个完整的了解。
在之前的几次体验中，灵游坊只是零零碎碎地交付过几个 Boss 战，以及非常短小的关卡流程，虽然从中得以感受到了游戏的核心玩法，但也难以得窥全豹。而通过这次封闭式的沉浸体验，让我从包括故事、角色、武器升级，技能树成长等更全面的角度，感受到了灵游坊的野心，以及这些年来对武侠朋克世界的精心雕琢。
据灵游坊介绍，本次提供的体验版本几乎就是游戏的完整版，虽然当时游戏尚未封版，但是所有的内容开发已经完成，项目组已经进入 debug 和调整优化的阶段。从当天试玩的表现来看，至少在游戏前几个小时里，我没有遇到任何影响游戏进程的严重 bug，总体来说表现还比较稳定。
游戏开场阶段以一段主角魂的闪回拉开了序幕，魂在“影境”武林这个隐秘的江湖世界中，将以剩下的六十六天生命为界限，展开一段前往庞镇的冒险。关于游戏剧情方面，为了避免剧透，我不会在这里透露太多。如果你接触过《影之刃》之前的几款作品，那当然会在本作中看到很多熟悉的面孔，但即便是你第一次接触这个系列，也完全不会影响你沉浸于游戏的世界之中，所以新晋玩家倒也不必担心。
本作的主要流程部分，采用了箱庭式关卡设计，既不是完全的开放式世界，也并非强制性的线性冒险。以我试玩的前两个关卡来看，游戏的大地图采用了无缝的水墨风格绘画，通过探索的方式揭开地图的迷雾，只要是打开过的区域均可以自由来回。游戏中还设计了一些需要后期的技能道具或者特定剧情才能进入的区域，这些都要经由玩家推进剧情后逐步开启。
庞镇自然是整个地图的中心，但延展开来也有不同的地貌和风景，搭配本作特有的武侠朋克风，玩家在游戏中既能看到景色秀丽的山水，也可以进入蒸汽驱动的钢铁高塔，这些看似风格迥异的视觉元素，在游戏里都得到了很好的融合，不觉突兀但又特征明显，为整个游戏提供了极其沉浸式的冒险舞台。
游戏的战斗系统是玩法的核心驱动力，汲取港式武侠电影的喧哗风格，来自中国传统武术和民间传说的灵感，打造出一套在高速动作中展现武打美学的独特风格。
主角除了常规的普通攻击、格挡和闪避外，在战斗过程中需要密切注意敌人释放的蓝光和红光技能。蓝光技能可进行格挡，在敌人攻击即将命中的瞬间再按格挡可实现完美格挡。红光技能无法格挡只能闪避，在敌人攻击即将命中的瞬间再按闪避可实现完美闪避。无论是完美格挡还是完美闪避，除了有更华丽的演出效果，还能创造绝佳的反击机会，再现了高手对决胜负在闪念之间的武侠秘意。
战斗系统中最核心的是名为“杀气”的系统，它有点类似魂类游戏的体力系统，但又完全不同。无论是进攻还是防御，都需要消耗一定的杀气，这就构成了游戏中最基本的战术系统，如果你把杀气全部用于进攻，则当你需要防御时会因为没有杀气而无法维持防御状态。不过好在游戏中每把武器的杀气是独立的，可以通过切换武器来恢复杀气，而不同的武器往往代表着不同的战斗节奏。
另外与常规战斗中消耗的杀气相独立的，还有名为“精纯杀气”的系统。一方面，它需要通过在进攻中消耗普通杀气来积攒，另一方面，当需要释放当前主武器绝技的时候，就需要用到它。绝技大部分是会自动连续进攻的必杀技，在释放过程中还有可以打断敌人进攻的效果，在战斗中把握好释放时机，有可能达成扭转战局的效果。
游戏为玩家准备了 30 把主武器，以及 25 把称为“影之武装”的副武器，这些取材自传统武侠世界并融入蒸汽朋克风格和元素打造的趁手兵器，均有着各自的特长和对应技能，通过主副武器的搭配，每个玩家都能搭配出各自不同的战斗风格，帮助玩家在游戏中摧城拔寨斩妖除魔。部分副武器还具有特别的探索功能，例如“巨凶斧”用来劈开道路障碍，“追命锁镰”用来钩住远处的锚点等等。所有武器均可通过消耗相应道具来升级，解锁新的形态和招式，不断产生新的战斗搭配，而这些升级都可以进行重置并将素材用以升级其他武器，以便玩家随时更换更擅长或者更好用的武器。
除了武器外，装备、饰品和技能树系统也是陪伴着玩家成长的重要系统。装备和饰品为玩家提供各种防御和技能效果，在面对特定地形或者特定敌人的时候，某些特定装备会发挥奇效。并且玩家可对不同部位对的装备进行自由组合，以便实现最大化的的增益。而技能树会随着玩家等级的提高进行升级，最初有三条在进攻、防御和技能路径，随着玩家的等级越来越高，这三条路径会相互融会贯通，相互之间形成依赖和因果关系，实现更复杂的技能组合。
在前几个小时的试玩过程中，我仔细探索了游戏的第一个章节关卡，除了有一块特定区域需要到游戏中期才能进入外，我把第一关几乎“舔”了个遍。本作有一个比较特别的设定，就是游戏中的杂兵不会重生，只要你突破和清理过的区域，之后就可以很安全的反复来回，即便通过游戏中的“铃铛”（类似魂类游戏篝火的效果）进行休息或传送，也不会让杂兵重生，这个设定倒是方便了玩家在地图中穿梭收集。
对杂兵而言，不同帮派的杂兵也存在敌对关系，你在游戏推进过程中会看到有不同派别的杂兵相互群殴的情况，你可以在一旁坐收渔翁之利，也可以直接上去让两派都获得清净。但与其他动作游戏类似的是，即便主角身手矫健，也要绝对避免陷入杂兵的围攻之中，俗话说的“好汉难敌四手”。
而在关卡中的特定位置，会有 Boss 级敌兵等待着玩家前来挑战。例如早期的疯狂暴徒“残钢”，是很明显的新手教学 Boss，他的进攻结构清晰，大多数招式都有很明显的前摇，目的就是为了让玩家适应 Boss 战的节奏。第一关的主要 Boss 斧老大“彭猛”则是一位力量型的 Boss，他的招式大开大合，无论是身型还是打击效果都让整个屏幕为之震颤，击败他之后就会获得“巨凶斧”可用来开山辟路的副武器。而后期的剑痴“花千笑”则带有较长的剧情演出动画，显然是游戏中份量较重的主要反派。
在主游戏之外，活动现场还提供了另外两个游戏中后期的 Boss 以供体验，一位是双蛇夫人“白赤练”，另一位是舞狮尊主“烈焰”。这两个 Boss 着重让我体验到了，在游戏后期随着武器和技能升级后，所能呈现出的战斗效果。同时也展现了 Boss 战中合理利用机制的设计，例如与“烈焰”的战斗中，因为狮子头带有火属性攻击，如果直接硬刚很容易受到较大伤害，但如果在游戏中找到水缸并泼洒到它身上，则能大幅度降低火焰伤害，从而降低 Boss 战的难度。
在数个小时的体验中，我能充分感受到游戏所营造的沉浸感，至少从第一关的设计来看，无论是主线还是支线的安排都非常紧凑，我非常自然的随着流程的推进，根据主线的引导，在途中遇到各种支线任务，再通过逐步的探索和收集来完成任务，几乎没有出现在地图上不知道干什么而四处闲逛的情况。
游戏的战斗节奏感也非常明显，更多考验的是玩家在战斗过程中的注意力，并利用机制鼓励玩家多进攻少防守，通过见招拆招来实现错落有致的进攻套路，再搭配不同的武器和技能组合，打起来你来我回赏心悦目，战斗胜利后有一种独特的成就感和舒适感。
为了满足不同水平的玩家，游戏设置了四种不同的难度可供选择，前三档分别命名为入阵者（简单）、破局者（正常）和逆天者（极难），主要差别除了体现在主角血量和敌兵伤害这些数值之外，逆天者的敌兵 AI 也会有所调整，不仅敌兵的进攻欲望和频率会增加，甚至还有新的技能和连招出现。最后一档“六十六天”的难度与逆天者相当，但是在增加难度基础上提供了更为苛刻的仅有 66 条命的玩法模式，相信也是很多硬核玩家在熟悉游戏流程后会来挑战的难度。
总体来看，游戏有着浓郁的港式武侠的风味，无论是自己玩还是看别人玩，都能感受到特有的风范。尤其是国际影星甄子丹的出演，让游戏具备了更多的影视观感，由他扮演的金面具黑衣人“魔渊”将在游戏中多次与玩家相遇，并在整个剧情中起到非常关键的作用。
我们会在游戏发售前进行更完整的游戏评测，《影之刃零》将在 10 月 29 日发售，登陆 PS5 及 PC 平台。

title: 《克拉克森的农场》将推出汽车主题特别篇
text:
短暂回归老本行
Prime Video确认，《克拉克森的农场》将推出一集汽车主题特别篇。主持人杰里米·克拉克森将暂时回归老本行，重拾他在《巅峰拍档（Top Gear）》和《大世界之旅（The Grand Tour）》中主持汽车节目的经历。
在《杰里米「种」车：克拉克森的农场特别篇》中，克拉克森将尝试用自家Diddly Squat农场出产的农产品，「种」出并打造一辆属于自己的汽车。Prime称，这将是世界首创。
克拉克森将以捷豹F-Type V6S为基础，用自家农场出产的皮革制作内饰，用羊毛制作地毯，来修复这辆车。他还将尝试种植亚麻，获取纤维并将其制成可持续的亚麻复合材料，用来替代碳纤维。Prime称，各大汽车制造商已经开始关注这种材料。
传奇汽车设计师、大英帝国司令勋章获得者伊恩·卡勒姆（Ian Callum）将协助克拉克森完成造车计划。卡勒姆设计了初代捷豹F-Type，以及捷豹XK、C-X75和阿斯顿·马丁Vanquish、DB7、DB9。他还参与了福特RS200和日产R390的设计。
《杰里米「种」车：克拉克森的农场特别篇》将于2027年播出。

title: 汤姆·克鲁斯新电影《挖掘者》面临巨大亏损
text:
分歧未带动票房
据TheWrap报道，评价两极分化的气候变化讽刺电影《挖掘者（Digger）》预计在结束上映时亏损2.5亿美元（约合人民币16.76亿元）。TheWrap称，影片首周末票房表现令人担忧，美国本土仅收获800万美元（约合人民币5364万元），海外票房则为1200万美元（约合人民币8045万元）。华纳兄弟的新母公司Skydance内部人士因此预计，《挖掘者》的全球总票房不会超过4000万美元（约合人民币2.68亿元）。
华纳兄弟尚未就这些说法发表评论。派拉蒙正在以1100亿美元（约合人民币7375亿元）收购华纳兄弟，这笔交易颇具争议。此后，华纳兄弟将与派拉蒙一同归属母公司Skydance。
《挖掘者》由连续两届获得奥斯卡最佳导演奖的亚历杭德罗·冈萨雷斯·伊尼亚里图（《鸟人》《荒野猎人》）执导，影坛传奇汤姆·克鲁斯主演，但影评人和观众对影片的评价都存在分歧。有人试图利用这些褒贬不一的反应为影片造势，但似乎未能让更多观众产生购票观影的兴趣。

title: XBOX新设XP部门拓展娱乐业务
text:
不止于游戏
XBOX宣布成立名为XP的新部门，负责电视、电影及娱乐业务。该部门将由曾在Lucasfilm任职多年的Kayleen Walters领导。她此前担任《我的世界》开发商Mojang的总裁，任职期间还担任了去年上映的《我的世界大电影》的执行制片人。
Kayleen Walters XP整合了四大「投入领域」：XBOX Pictures、XBOX Products、XBOX Partnerships和XBOX Places。微软表示，成立XP是为了帮助XBOX成为全球第一的娱乐与游戏公司，而实现这一目标需要让旗下大型系列走出电子游戏本身。不过，XP并不是制作公司；微软希望寻找合适的合作伙伴，在电影、电视、线下体验及消费产品领域展开合作。
微软在影视领域已经取得了显著成功：华纳兄弟的《我的世界大电影》打破了票房纪录，亚马逊的《辐射》剧集也创下了Prime Video的纪录。即将推出的XBOX改编作品包括电影续作《我的世界大电影2》、《辐射》第三季、Peter Berg和Taylor Sheridan参与的《使命召唤》电影，以及与Netflix合作的《暗黑破坏神》动画剧集。小岛秀夫的《PHYSINT》是《潜龙谍影》的精神续作，微软就该作签订的协议包含影视改编权，因此可以期待它最终也会推出改编作品。
XP还负责现场活动，而XBOX在这方面同样已有成功经验。暴雪在暴雪嘉年华上公布了多项重要消息，35000人来到加利福尼亚州阿纳海姆的活动现场，另有1250万人在家观看。最近一次《我的世界》直播活动宣布了该作14年来的首个新维度，触达人数超过1.44亿。此外，微软还列举了《战争机器》与WWE的联动，以及XBOX与宜家合作推出的家具系列等合作项目。《我的世界》主题乐园计划于明年开门迎客。
Walters表示：「XP的成立源于一个简单却有力量的信念：世界上最受喜爱的游戏系列，有机会突破游戏本身的边界，触达更多人。粉丝不只是玩我们的游戏。他们还会观看改编作品、穿戴周边、参加相关活动、为这些系列庆祝，并以无数种方式与它们建立联系。XP汇集了相关团队，帮助XBOX旗下系列以更广泛、更有意义的方式走进人们的生活。」
XBOX首席执行官Asha Sharma在一份发给全公司的备忘录中写道：「XP这个名字借用了经验值（Experience Points）的概念，也正式确立了我们的四大投入领域：XBOX Pictures负责影视改编；XBOX Products负责授权与周边商品；XBOX Partnerships负责赞助商和品牌合作；XBOX Places负责我们的重磅直播及线下活动、主题乐园，以及其他依托实体场所的体验。」这份备忘录也发布在了XBOX Wire上。
「我们的系列带给人们的意义，可以超越他们花在游戏上的时间。Kayleen知道如何与业界合作打造这些体验，同时保留最初让人们喜爱这些系列的核心。」
微软指出，影视作品取得成功也能带动旗下电子游戏的表现。例如，《辐射》第一季播出期间，XBOX Game Pass上的《辐射》游戏游玩时长增至原来的5倍。而自电影上映以来，《我的世界》的周活跃用户数同比增长超过75％，这一数据截至2026年4月30日。
如果这听起来有些熟悉，那是因为微软以前就尝试过。2012年微软宣布成立XBOX Entertainment Studios，目标是制作直接在XBOX主机上播出的电视节目。XES曾公布计划，为《战争机器》《神鬼寓言》《极限竞速》和《腐烂国度》制作剧集。当然，还有斯蒂芬·斯皮尔伯格在E3上宣布的最初版《光环》剧集，他原定担任执行制片人。他们甚至计划制作一部名为《Every Street United》的无剧本街头足球节目。XBOX One在2013年公布后，其「一体化」宣传理念未能引起玩家共鸣，整个XES项目仅持续了两年便被关闭。
作为此次调整的一部分，Mojang也迎来了新负责人。Maria Angelidou-Smith加入XBOX，担任Mojang首席执行官。她曾在Meta工作近十年，负责Facebook Groups，随后先后任职于Personio和Reddit，并在Reddit担任首席产品官。Sharma表示：「她打造过数十亿人使用的产品，也带领产品和工程团队经历了大规模增长与变革。她将把这些经验带到Mojang，同时向最了解《我的世界》的人学习。她上任后的首要任务，是向那些让《我的世界》如此特别的团队和社区学习。」
当然，在Sharma持续推进「重置」的过程中，《我的世界》是XBOX正在加大投入的主要系列之一。本财年至今，这轮调整已使游戏业务裁员近2000人。《我的世界》累计销量超过4.25亿份，是史上最畅销的电子游戏。其规模庞大的周边商品业务也已跻身全球前20。

title: 乐高推出「漫威天际线」套装
text:
微缩还原多项漫威场景
纽约漫展正在热烈举行，活动将持续至10月11日。乐高借此机会公布了一款新的漫威套装，名为「漫威天际线」，共含1261块积木。这款套装力求以微缩比例还原漫威宇宙中最知名的建筑，还配有行星吞噬者人仔。套装将于1月发售，售价为99.99美元。
乐高「漫威天际线」套装收录了漫威宇宙中众多建筑的微缩模型，数量比乍看之下还要多。其中包括《蜘蛛侠》中的号角日报大楼、复仇者大厦、《神奇四侠》中的巴克斯特大厦，以及金并的菲斯克大厦，此外还有许多建筑。除了建筑，空中还飞着多种生物和飞行器，包括复仇者联盟的昆式战机、神奇四侠的「精益求精号」飞船，以及X战警的X-Jet战机。微缩霹雳火在巴克斯特大厦上空划出了数字4，周围甚至还有一头俯冲飞行的齐塔瑞利维坦。套装也包含微缩蜘蛛侠。
有些乐高爱好者不喜欢微缩套装，但我很喜欢。要用这么少的细小积木拼出能让人认出来的东西，设计师就得在这种极小比例下发挥更多创意。在这款套装的比例下，行星吞噬者人仔置身建筑之间，看起来格外庞大，很符合这个角色的形象。总体而言，这款套装在有限的空间里容纳了大量细节。

title: 《GTA6》公布部分游戏内电台及歌曲
text:
步行也能听电台
Rockstar上线了一个新网站，玩家可以在网站上试听《GTA6》中的部分电台与歌曲。
Rockstar表示，《GTA6》的游戏内电台将提供「迄今数量最多、涵盖范围最广的内容」，并一如既往地邀请Morgan Wallen、Lana Del Rey等多位明星担任电台主持。至于玩家能听到哪些内容，以下是Rockstar目前公布的全部电台及部分歌曲。
目前已确认的《GTA6》全部电台：
Cocoteo FM：雷奥奈达最出色的现代拉丁音乐电台。由El Martillo（Bad Bunny配音）和La Gata（RaiNao配音）主持，播放的音乐涵盖巴恰塔、梅伦格、Dembow和雷鬼顿等多种风格。Cocoteo FM就是一场「永不停歇的派对」。
已确认歌曲：
- Bad Bunny - EoO
- Axel Rulay ft. Farruko & El Alfa - Si Es Trucho Es Trucho (Remix)
- Romeo Santos & El Chaval de la Bachata - Canalla
Back Country Radio：MW（Morgan Wallen配音）和Delta Dawne（Lana Del Rey配音）将叛逆不羁的乡村音乐传遍Grassrivers、Port Gellhorn以及更远的地区。别忘了收听Back Country的流动记者、沼泽气象员，同时也是Delta那位算不上秘密的情人——Mud Dog Mike（Jeremy Dufrene配音）的现场报道。他会坐在自己的Grassrivers风扇艇驾驶座上，随时向电台传回最新消息。
已确认歌曲：
- David Allan Coe - Need a Little Time Off for Bad Behavior
- Loretta Lynn - Don't Come Home A-Drinkin' (With Lovin' On Your Mind)
- Hank Williams, Jr. & Waylon Jennings - The Conversation
AfroBank FM： 跟着Burna（Burna Boy配音）和Palmsy（Palms Trax配音）一起把音乐声开大吧！这对AfroBank FM的活力搭档精心挑选了最出色的非洲音乐，从20世纪的经典作品和鲜为人知的佳作，到Amapiano、3-step等当代音乐风格，应有尽有。
已确认歌曲：
- Asake - Joha
- Pat Thomas ft. Ebo Taylor - Gye Wani
- DJ Lag & Robot Boii ft. Kamo Mphela - Shay'sana
The Chamber 106.6： 狂暴的金属乐已经登陆雷奥奈达。加入DJ Kerry（Kerry King配音）和DJ Tom（Tom Araya配音）的狂欢现场，一起聆听20世纪80年代及之后的经典金属乐，感受雷奥奈达深厚的金属音乐传统。
已确认歌曲：
- Black Sabbath - I
- Pantera - I'm Broken
- Slayer - Raining Blood
Flash FM： 罪恶城的经典电台，由Robyn（本人配音）和Alex（Alex Consani配音）共同主持，为听众带来最出色的流行音乐。无论你身处这座「欢乐之州」的哪个角落，Flash FM都保证能让你跟着音乐跳起来。
已确认歌曲：
- Charli xcx - Good Ones
- MGMT - Electric Feel
- Zara Larsson & PinkPantheress - Midnight Sun (Girls Trip)
Dirty South Classics：Trick（Trick Daddy配音）和Trina（本人配音）将为听众送上一份南方热情，播放当地经典说唱与嘻哈音乐。从海滩到街头，没有谁比他们更能代表雷奥奈达和美国南方的音乐文化。
已确认歌曲：
- David Banner ft. Lil' Flip - Like A Pimp
- JT Money ft. Solé - Who Dat
- DJ Khaled ft. Trick Daddy, Rick Ross & Pitbull - Born N Raised
虽然目前只公布了一小部分内容，但已足以确认游戏中的音乐风格相当多样，其中包括Charli XCX、Bad Bunny、MGMT、DJ Khaled和Black Sabbath等音乐人的作品。目前尚不清楚Rockstar是否会在发售前公布《GTA6》的完整曲目列表，不过，这些内容已经让我们对11月19日能听到什么有了相当清晰的了解。此外，Rockstar还确认《GTA6》支持玩家通过耳机和智能手机，在步行时收听点播播客与电台。这是粉丝多年来一直盼望的重要功能，因为此前玩家只能在载具和部分建筑内收听电台。如今，玩家在战斗、徒步探索等情况下也能自由听音乐。
9月，Rockstar确认将发行一张专辑，收录专为《GTA6》创作的原创音乐。目前，Rockstar已确认其中包含Travis Scott、Morgan Wallen、Keith Richards等人的原创歌曲。完整曲目列表尚未公布，不过，如果本月晚些时候或11月初、游戏发售前有更多专辑消息，也并不令人意外。
GTA6将于11月19日登陆XBOX Series和PS5。

title: 派拉蒙筹拍《赛博朋克2077》真人电影
text:
夜之城走向大银幕
派拉蒙影业正在开发《赛博朋克2077》真人电影。
据Deadline报道，影片将由Lorenzo di Bonaventura担任制片人，他最为人熟知的制片作品是《变形金刚》和《特种部队》系列电影。CDPR也将参与制片，不过目前尚无消息透露哪些演员、编剧或导演将参与该项目。目前还不清楚，影片会忠实改编2020年推出的同名游戏，还是像Netflix动画剧集《赛博朋克：边缘行者》那样，讲述赛博朋克宇宙中的另一段故事。
如果影片直接改编游戏，派拉蒙已经有现成的明星阵容可以借力。游戏中，基努·里维斯饰演强尼·银手，这个激进角色风格类似泰勒·德顿，存在于主角的脑海中。伊德瑞斯·艾尔巴也在资料片《往日之影》中加入了游戏的演员阵容。这段故事感觉很适合改编，应该会很酷，不过用它来引导大众观众认识这个宇宙，效果可能没那么好。无论如何，得知夜之城将登上大银幕，还是很让人兴奋的。
CDPR也正在全力开发下一部《赛博朋克》游戏，预计将在《巫师4》之后发售。因此，我们可能最早也要等到2029年或2030年才能玩到这部新作。不过，这个时间或许恰到好处，因为《赛博朋克》电影可能也要到那时才能完成。里维斯已经表示有兴趣参演下一部《赛博朋克》游戏，所以他或许也会在大银幕上饰演强尼·银手。
派拉蒙正大力投入热门游戏改编电影，旗下的《街头霸王》将于下周末上映。2028年，派拉蒙还将推出由泰勒·谢里丹编剧、彼得·博格执导的《使命召唤》电影。考虑到派拉蒙刚刚与华纳兄弟合并，也因此拥有了大量可供利用的新IP。

title: 《极限竞速：地平线6》PS5版定档，明年1月26日发售
text:
首个大型DLC也将同步登场
《极限竞速：地平线6》终于将在1月登陆PS5，届时还将同步推出一个大型DLC。游戏现已开启预购，港区PlayStation Store标准版定价498港币，豪华版定价714港币，尊享版定价854港币。
最新预告片确认，《极限竞速：地平线6》将于1月26日登陆PS5。游戏的首个大型DLC也将于同日推出，不过具体内容尚未公布。与XBOX和PC版一样，玩家可以预购高级版，获得额外奖励，包括提前五天在PS5上游玩。预购PS5版任意版本的玩家还将获得一辆预先调校好的法拉利J50。
此前有传闻称，《极限竞速：地平线6》PS5版将无法按原计划在2026年内推出。此次公布的发售日期证实了这一传闻，不过这个档期恰好能让本作避开《GTA6》的冲击。这应该能确保游戏在PS5上取得良好表现，并吸引可观的玩家群体。《极限竞速：地平线5》去年登陆PS5时大获成功，因此玩家对续作的需求也很强烈。

title: 漫威公布间谍新剧集《Zodiac》，将于2028年播出
text:
神盾局的秘密
漫威影业公布了全新剧集《Zodiac》，将于2028年播出。
该剧在纽约漫展上正式公布，不过上个月就已有相关报道。好莱坞报道者在报道《夜魔侠：重生》被取消时，曾顺带提到这部剧。目前关于该项目的信息不多，只知道它讲述的是一个间谍故事，似乎将围绕漫威旗下的秘密政府组织神盾局展开。
漫威确认，该剧将在未来几周启动选角，明年开拍。与其他漫威电影宇宙剧集一样，该剧将在Disney+首播。除了确定它是一部间谍惊悚剧之外，具体剧情仍不清楚，我们也不知道哪些漫威英雄会登场。考虑到尼克·弗瑞在神盾局中的身份，如果塞缪尔·杰克逊饰演的这一角色登场，也不会令人意外。我们只能希望它比《秘密入侵》更好，毕竟那部由杰克逊主演的剧集被认为是失败之作。
由于该剧将于2028年播出，故事也可能设定在《复仇者联盟6》之后，杰克逊已确认会出演这部电影。接下来的两部《复仇者联盟》电影预计将为漫威电影宇宙更大规模的重置打下基础，不过漫威影业负责人凯文·费奇否认这会是对整个系列的彻底重启。

title: 《生化危机 安魂曲》原本计划做成网游
text:
重新把恐怖放在首位
《生化危机 安魂曲》制作人川田将央透露，本作最初计划做成网络游戏，但团队后来放弃了这一想法，转而专注于恐怖体验。
川田将央在《BIOHAZARD 30th Special Mook》中分享了这一消息。这本面向粉丝的全彩杂志书共124页，收录了系列完整时间线、生物谱系及开发者访谈。
根据粉丝翻译，川田将央表示：「每款游戏的开发都是不断试错的过程。比如《生化危机 安魂曲》，（游戏总监中西晃史）最初甚至已经按网络游戏的方向展开了开发。不过，开发中途的调研结果并不理想，因此我们决定再次把恐怖理念放在首位，放弃了网络游戏的方向。」
这并不是川田将央在这本杂志书中透露的唯一一件令人意外的事。他还表示，里昂是团队最早选定的主角，但团队最终认为，如果玩家能轻松砍杀丧尸，游戏就会过于偏重「动作」，整体恐怖感也会减弱。
他接着说：「里昂也是最早确定以主角身份登场的角色。不过，我们判断，如果只有擅长战斗的里昂，恐怖就无法成立，因此决定引入新角色格蕾丝。」
川田将央也解释了卡普空为何没有早早公布里昂会在本作中登场：「这款游戏会同时展现恐怖与动作两面，而我们直到最后才揭晓游戏的全貌，成功让大家在发售前一直保持关注。」
中西晃史早期打算将《生化危机 安魂曲》做成网络游戏，并不完全令人意外。毕竟，在《生化危机7》的概念构思阶段，卡普空管理层也曾要求加入多人模式和微交易。系列制作人竹内润在2022年表示：「就在那段时间，卡普空大力推动营销，强调我们必须做出玩家想要的游戏。所以我们一直被要求做这个、做那个，当时的总监们真的很难。一下要在线多人模式，一下要可下载内容。还要持续运营！微交易！做一款把这些要求全部满足的《生化危机》！多人模式的想法很快就被否决了。如果能把各个部分妥善整合，我们就能做出一款刺激的多人恐怖游戏，但我们实在没有什么好点子，所以先把它搁置了。我们顺着清单逐一砍掉这些内容，最后做出了营销部门最不想看到的东西——一款普普通通的传统单人恐怖游戏。」
卡普空正全力推进旗下多个知名IP，《生化危机》便是其中之一。系列刚刚推出了由扎克·克雷格执导的改编电影，《生化危机 维罗妮卡 重制版》则定于明年2月发售。既然《生化危机 安魂曲》的开发团队没有继续推进网络游戏版本，那么我们未来或许还会看到另一款《生化危机》网络游戏——也许会是另一部《生化危机：爆发》？

title: 凯尔·加尔纳想演《赛博朋克2077》真人电影里的V
text:
「带我去夜之城」
《危笑2》演员凯尔·加尔纳（Kyle Gallner）公开表示，他已经准备好，也愿意在派拉蒙的《赛博朋克2077》真人改编电影中饰演V。
从桌面角色扮演游戏起步，到如今的《赛博朋克2077》，这个系列已经走过了很长一段路。CDPR推出的电子游戏及其出色的资料片，加上扳机社制作、广受好评的衍生动画《赛博朋克：边缘行者》，让这个冷峻科幻系列的粉丝大饱眼福。粉丝接下来还能看到更多作品：派拉蒙透露，正在开发一部改编自该系列的真人电影。目前，我们还不清楚任何剧情细节，因此影片可能会讲述V与强尼·银手的冒险，也可能聚焦伊德瑞斯·艾尔巴饰演的所罗门·李德在遇见V之前的经历——甚至说不定会讲《赛博朋克：边缘行者2》中微克·金斯利的故事，谁知道呢！
我们可以确定的是，这部电影有着丰富的可能性，而这正是粉丝如此兴奋的原因。演员凯尔·加尔纳也是这些粉丝中的一员，他迫不及待地想以男性版V的身份踏入夜之城。
派拉蒙于10月8日公布消息后仅过了几个小时，加尔纳就发布了一张自己的照片。照片中，他留着贴近头皮的短发，与游戏宣传素材中V的发型相似，配文是：「带我去夜之城。」可以肯定，粉丝对这一潜在选角相当热情，许多人已经开始想象加尔纳与基努·里维斯饰演的强尼·银手同台的画面。
一位粉丝写道：「凯尔和基努，听起来太棒了。」另一位则表示，选加尔纳出演会是「完美选角」。还有人评论道：「你和基努搭档？这个我可以支持。」又一位粉丝力挺道：「他就是V本人！派拉蒙，请考虑一下。」
目前，电影的具体信息仍处于保密状态，不过CDPR联席首席执行官Michał Nowakowski承诺，很快会公布更多消息。他在X上表示：「派拉蒙与我们对《赛博朋克》系列有着共同的创作抱负，我们很高兴未来能与他们合作。我们期待在适当的时候分享更多细节。」在等待更多消息的同时，粉丝还可以期待《赛博朋克：边缘行者2》。该作定于2026年10月20日在Netflix播出。

title: 《夜魔侠》主演查理·考克斯确认参演世嘉新作
text:
四十小时的美式口音
《夜魔侠》主演查理·考克斯确认，他又参演了一款电子游戏，这次是世嘉的作品。
考克斯在2026年纽约漫展上谈到了这个项目。他告诉IGN的Jeffrey Vega，自己已经为一款尚未公布的世嘉游戏完成了录音。
他说：「我又参与了一款！它还没有名字。我参与的是世嘉的一款游戏。那之后我又做了一款，还没推出。录制过程很有趣，也很难。这完全是另一种工作啊。」
考克斯接着分享了参与这款游戏时的一件趣事：制作团队原本并不知道他不是美国人。「我不确定哪些事可以说。他们邀请我参与这款游戏，我答应了，到了现场才第一次见到他们。我得录40个小时左右，具体多久我也记不清了。第一天到场时，我说，『大家好，很高兴见到你们！你们好吗？』所有人都愣了一下，说，『……哦，他是英国人。』他们原本希望找的是个美国人。但我现在得用另一种口音，录上40个小时的台词，而且事先没准备过这种口音。是啊，我想他们以为我是美国人。」
至少，我们由此得知了他在这款神秘游戏中所饰角色的一点信息：他将扮演一名美国人，或者至少是一个说话带美式口音的角色。考虑到他为这个角色录了40个小时的台词，这个角色很可能在剧情中占据重要地位。
值得一提的是，考克斯今年早些时候就确认自己正在参与一款新游戏，不过当时他同样没有透露太多细节。目前，我们知道的就只有这些。考克斯已在《光与影：33号远征》中证明了自己的配音实力。他为古斯塔夫配音，而且仅用一次四小时的录音就录完了全部台词，这件事广为人知。游戏于2025年发售后，他的表演获得了玩家的称赞，还让他获得了当年The Game Awards最佳表演奖的提名。
世嘉即将推出的游戏包括《异于天堂》《虚幻斗士 命运交锋》《女神异闻录6》和《异形：隔离2》等多部作品。考虑到考克斯参与的这个项目连名字都还没有，它不太可能是上述已经公布的游戏之一，具体会是什么，我们只能拭目以待。
与此同时，查理·考克斯的粉丝可以期待《夜魔侠：重生》第三季，不过这一季将为马特·默多克当前的冒险画上句号——至少暂时如此。这个消息在9月下旬传出，同期还有报道称，该剧主创达里奥·斯卡达潘在剧集进入后期制作阶段时退出了项目。
金并的饰演者文森特·多诺费奥在社交媒体上写下了一段真挚的告别文字：「我们的最后一季，也就是第三季，将在明年与大家见面，里面有一些非常精彩的内容。衷心感谢所有支持过我们的人。我爱菲斯克这个角色，永远都会爱。我要去别处了。与此同时……第三季就要来了！」
《夜魔侠：重生》第三季定于2027年初播出。

title: 《街头霸王6》制作人谈如何挽救系列
text:
从零开始
《街头霸王6》制作人松本修平透露，在《街头霸王5》时期，卡普空这款招牌格斗游戏系列曾面临多么严峻的处境，并解释了他与游戏总监中山贵之如何携手避免系列走向衰亡。
《街头霸王5》在2016年2月发售时遭遇重大挫折，早已不是什么秘密。许多玩家认为游戏是在尚未完成的状态下仓促推出的，不仅缺少街机模式、剧情模式等基本内容，在线对战也极不稳定。
2020年小野义德离开卡普空后，松本修平在《街头霸王5》运营后期接任制作人。他与游戏总监中山贵之都意识到，整个系列正处于危险之中。如果不尽快采取行动，《街头霸王》这个IP甚至可能在未来十年内逐渐淡出玩家视野。
松本在2026年10月接受Karin Ohira采访时表示：「在《街头霸王5》时期，我们两个人讨论过这个问题，并意识到，如果再不为《街头霸王》做些什么，这个IP可能会在十年后消亡。当时的情况已经非常危急。所以，我们必须把它做成一款能够让人们重新认识《街头霸王》、重新开始玩《街头霸王》的游戏。」
松本解释说，《街头霸王5》玩家群体的年龄不断增长，就是问题的一个体现。如果卡普空希望这个系列能够延续下去，就必须吸引更年轻的玩家。
他继续说道：「当时，《街头霸王5》的玩家年龄大致集中在35岁到45岁之间。再过十年，这些人就要60岁了。如果只依靠这批玩家，系列就很难维持下去。……《街头霸王》已经变成了一个离大家越来越遥远的存在。人们知道有这样一个游戏圈子，却没有真正去玩游戏。这让我们意识到：『这样下去不妙。』说到底，我们是一家游戏公司，但人们却不玩我们的游戏。这难道不是最致命的问题吗？所以，这才是最大的危机。我们不知道这些人是否还能继续保持同样程度的热情，而且任何事物都有自己的生命周期，对吧？正是在那个时候，我们讨论了这个问题：如果继续维持现状，这个IP很可能会在十年后消亡。」
那么，他们究竟是如何凭借《街头霸王6》如此彻底地扭转局面的？松本表示，团队决定不再依赖《街头霸王》作为经典IP的历史影响力，而是选择从零开始，把当代玩家完全不了解这个系列作为开发的前提：「虽然大家都说《街头霸王》知名度很高，但我们不能因此过于自信。我们决定采取一种态度：假设现在这一代玩家根本不认识我们。对于那些刚开始接触游戏的人，我们必须认真向他们解释各种事情，比如这些角色是谁、游戏应该怎么玩，而不能理所当然地认为他们已经了解《街头霸王》。」
松本还表示，《街头霸王6》的现代操作模式，是吸引新玩家的重要因素之一。除此之外，游戏还加入了多项降低入门门槛的功能，包括环球游历模式（目前已暂停，短期内没有恢复计划）、格斗中心，以及Vicious、Tasty Steve等社区知名人士提供的实时解说。

title: AMD确认2026年底前将FSR 4引入掌机
text:
只有新掌机？还是老的也兼容？
目前，即便是Steam Deck这样的早期掌机，也已经有办法使用AMD的FSR 4技术来提升游戏帧率。不过，今年6月，AMD并未承诺会正式为旧款掌机提供FSR 4支持，这让掌机玩家面临失望的可能。
如今，AMD消费级芯片业务负责人Jack Huynh表示，公司将在今年年底前把这项技术引入部分掌机设备。
但究竟是哪些掌机？目前仍不清楚FSR 4是否会登陆现有掌机，还是玩家必须购买新设备才能使用。因为这一消息公布的同时，AMD也透露将推出一款支持FSR 4的新芯片。
Huynh在接受韩国媒体The Elec采访时表示：「我们将在今年年底前，把最初应用于现有独立显卡、基于机器学习AI的FSR 4技术，扩展到包括APU、游戏笔记本电脑和掌机设备在内的整个产品线。我们计划从两个方向推进：面向现有APU提供支持，以及推出新的产品线。」
据The Elec称，这意味着AMD将在今年年底前推出一款新APU，同时为APU提供轻量化版本的FSR 4此前，AMD只承诺为桌面显卡提供FSR 4支持，并未承诺将其扩展到笔记本电脑和掌机使用的APU。不过，The Elec的报道似乎并未明确说明，这个轻量化版本的FSR 4是否会专门登陆掌机。或许，它需要依赖此前曝光的AMD下一代Ryzen Z3，或者代号为「Gainsborough」的掌机芯片才能运行。
今年早些时候，AMD曾给现有掌机获得FSR 4支持的期待泼过一盆冷水。当时，AMD高管David McAfee在接受Tom's Guide采访时表示：「我们希望确保实际体验和画面质量都达到应有的水平。」他还指出，只有设备具备「足够的计算能力」，引入FSR 4才有意义。

text: 终于从深渊的深处脱身而出，布罗塔托继续探索这颗致命的星球，却意外闯入了一片充满敌意的丛林。这片史前森林隐藏着许多秘密，因此要当心潜伏在阴影中的变异和机械强化掠食者……《土豆兄弟》「史前惧兽」DLC将于11月2日登陆PC平台，并预定于2027年初登陆PS5、PS4、XBOX、Switch、Switch 2、iOS及安卓平台。

title: 《警目如炬》试玩Demo宣传视频 | 3i计划
text: 《警目如炬（Militsioner）》首个公开试玩版现已在Steam平台上线。踏入游戏第一章节，在这座荒诞又诡异的小镇中结识形形色色的居民，同时还要时刻提防那个高高俯视着整座城市的巨型警察。想要活下去，你得先学会如何在街头周旋，再想办法从这里逃出去。游戏将于2027年登陆XBOX及PC平台。

title: 《小马岛2：熊猫马戏团》试玩测试宣传视频 | 3i计划
text: 《小马岛2：熊猫马戏团（Pony Island 2: Panda Circus）》是一场交替穿梭于时间、神话、神学以及电子游戏之间的旅行。你需要在逃脱地狱众神的同时，保持你的灵魂和理智的完好。这绝对不是关于小马的游戏。游戏将于2027年4月27日登陆PC平台。

title: 《峡谷》发售档期预告 | 3i计划
text: 在《峡谷（Canyons）》这款支持1至4人联机的PVE合作射击游戏中，玩家将在一个残酷且瞬息万变的世界中，遭遇被称为「觉醒者」的超自然生物，设法与其缔结血契以掌控它们的能力；驾驶庞大的履带基地车，探索危机四伏的峡谷；并建造属于你的避难所，在艰难抉择间保全船员的性命。游戏将于2027年11月登陆PS5、XBOX Series及PC平台。

title: 电影《机动战士高达SEED FREEDOM ZERO》先导预告
text: 迪兰达尔所提倡的、由基因决定人类命运的「命运计划」崩溃后，为了实现新的和平秩序，以奥布联合首长国代表卡嘉莉为中心， 世界和平监视机构「孔帕斯」的创立工作正不断推进。 C.E.74。在结束了大战的世界中，真无法找到自己该前进的道路。 就在此时，曾在过去战场上身经百战的机动战士，从扎夫特被移送至淤能碁吕岛的孔帕斯临时基地。 然而就在那晚，「强袭自由高达」被不明人士强行夺走。 为了阻止事态扩大、夺回被抢走的机体，也为了必须守护的事物，真等人再次投身于战斗之中——。电影《机动战士高达SEED FREEDOM ZERO》将于2027年1月15日在日本地区影院上映。

title: 《漫威宇宙入侵》「杜姆城围城战」DLC发售日预告
text: 神奇四侠最强成员与他们的头号宿敌正式登场！《漫威宇宙入侵》「杜姆城围城战」DLC将解锁隐形女与毁灭博士两名可操控角色，同时新增以杜姆城为舞台的全新游戏模式。《漫威宇宙入侵》「杜姆城围城战」DLC将于11月10日发售。

title: PS5版《极限竞速：地平线6》发售日预告
text: 随着地平线嘉年华席卷日本，探索丰富的故事内容，参与各种竞速赛事。您将作为游客开启旅程，参与地平线邀请赛，证明自己拥有在嘉年华大放异彩的实力。当您暂别赛道时，可自由探索日本各地，揭开隐藏的秘密，为收藏日志收集印章。《极限竞速：地平线6》将于2027年1月26日登陆PS5平台。

title: 《使命召唤：现代战争4》「无人区：剧情任务」宣传视频
text: 每块区域，都有你需要的东西。每次任务，都会让你深入险境。执行剧情任务，完成一系列目标，深入无人区各个区域搜集情报、迎接挑战，并逐步揭开背后的完整故事。《使命召唤：现代战争4》将于10月23日登陆PS5、XBOX Series、Switch 2及PC平台。

title: 《银松镇》发售宣传视频
text: 《银松镇（Silver Pines）》是一款生存、恐怖、类银河战士恶魔城游戏，背景设定在美国小镇。在噩梦般的恐怖中奋战，破解重重谜题，同时管理稀缺资源，逐步揭开那些可能掌握救赎之钥的谜团。游戏现已登陆PS5、XBOX Series、Switch、Switch 2及PC平台。

title: 《双点博物馆》「失落游乐园」DLC发售宣传视频
text: 心动不如行动！双点博物馆正在招募游乐专家，前往废弃的变速游乐场进行探险行动，发掘全新的设计图和性能模块，扩建一间全新的博物馆。当博物馆遇上游乐园，让新博物馆「废氪迪乐园」完美融合双方特点！也可以称它为「博物乐园」。这座全新的游乐博物馆不仅拥有双点县历史上最经典的游乐设施，馆内专家们还可以通过设计图打造沉浸式游乐设施，与现有的博物馆主题相辅相成，为访客们重现历史。《双点博物馆》「失落游乐园」DLC现已发售。

title: 主机版《四海兄弟3：最终版》发售宣传视频
text: 1968年，世道早已改变。多年越战归来后，林肯·克莱明白了这个真理：家人并不是伴你而生的人，而是你愿意为之赴死的人。《四海兄弟3：最终版》首次将游戏本体、全部剧情DLC，以及奖励礼包捆绑在一起发布，游戏现已登陆PS5及XBOX Series平台，支持60帧游戏帧率，并带来多项技术优化。

title: 《饿狼传说：群狼之城》「佐野万次郎」角色预告
text: 作为东京卍会总长，被称为「无敌的Mikey」的绝对存在。凭借压倒性的实力和魅力，统治着不良界的顶点。来自人气动画《东京卍复仇者》的「佐野万次郎（Mikey）」将于10月22日作为季票3的DLC角色加入《饿狼传说：群狼之城》。

title: 《饿狼传说：群狼之城》「龙宫寺 坚」角色预告
text: 东京卍会副总长通称Draken。是总长Mikey的绝对搭档、左膀右臂和心灵支柱。来自人气动画《东京卍复仇者》的「龙宫寺 坚」将于10月22日作为季票3的DLC角色加入《饿狼传说：群狼之城》。

title: 《战锤40K：战争黎明4》「星际战士」阵营预告
text: 星际战士，人类最强大的战士，他们是经过基因强化的超级士兵，在数个世纪的战争与对帝皇坚定不移的忠诚中淬炼而成。在克洛诺斯，两大传奇战团响应了战争的号召。神秘的血鸦偏爱侦察、渗透与精准打击。他们潜入敌后，收集情报并直击软肋。而黑暗天使崇尚正面强攻，部署重装甲阵型，以纯粹的火力优势展开无情猛攻。《战锤40K：战争黎明4（Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War IV）》将于12月3日登陆PC平台，购买了「指挥官版」的玩家可于11月30日抢先体验游戏。

title: 关于《影之刃零》你要知道的12件事
text: 在最近的《影之刃零》闭门试玩采访中，制作人梁其伟进一步聊到了游戏的战斗逻辑、关卡探索、支线任务以及多周目玩法。相比此前对外内容中主要展示的战斗部分，这次采访也让我们能够进一步了解《影之刃零》的整体玩法，以及这款游戏真正想呈现的内容。

title: 为什么电子游戏保存应成为常态
text:
编者按
本文来自作家、游戏智慧（ Game-Wisdom.com ）创始人乔希·拜瑟（Josh Bycer）的 个人博客 ，由 indienova 取得授权并以 AI 译制初稿，人工审校的形式发表，链接见文末。原文发布于 2021 年 3 月 31 日。如存在译制错漏或不佳阅读体验，请随时留言反馈。
原文作者：乔希·拜瑟
前言
过去一周（注：2021 年 3 月），又发生了一起某数字商店及其所有游戏下架的事件。索尼正在关闭 PS3、PSP 和 PS Vita 商店，游戏产业的又一部分内容也因此让许多人无法再获取。我的粉丝们知道，我是游戏保存的大力支持者，在这篇文章中，我想谈谈我的期望，以及为什么模拟器如此重要。
图片：任天堂
享受游戏的困难
和往常一样，有必要谈谈为什么这个话题很重要。电子游戏与其他娱乐媒介相比有其独特之处，因为很多游戏都是与平台绑定的。关于模拟器的第一个批评点是，你可以玩到很多游戏的在线版本，比如通过任天堂 Switch、PSN 和 Xbox Network 的过往作品库。不幸的是，这存在几个问题。因为过往作品库绑定在各自平台上，意味着它们仍然被锁在相应的客户端中。
很多 Wii 和 Wii U 平台上的经典游戏，在任天堂 Switch 商店里并没有。而随着索尼关闭旗下一些在线商店的消息传来，如果它们消失了，那么其中所有可玩的游戏也会随之消失。
另一个常见的批评点是“只要把你的硬件保养好就行”，但有几个明显的问题。首先，大多数人不花高价根本找不到这些旧主机，即使找到了，也不能保证买到的机器还能再用几年。即便是像 The MADE 这样的机构有一些旧主机库存，但供应量仍然有限。另一个不常被提及的点是所需的额外硬件：电视、合适的连接线、接口等等。游戏产业一直觉得电视制造商会永远保留 AV 接口，但现在我们已经来到 HD 世界了，淘汰这些接口只是时间问题。一旦出现这种情况，游戏保存的选择将更少，公众体验这些游戏也会变得更难。
正如我之前说过的，我知道要求开发商和平台保证完全向下兼容并不公平。随着硬件和新技术的发展，在进步的同时还要支持旧硬件变得越来越困难，这也是数字版游戏变得如此流行的原因。但正如我们所见，仅仅有在线平台是不够的，我想就如何实现这种保存提出一个建议。
GOG 对 PC 游戏保存来说是一大福音，但没有对应的主机版本/图片：Twitter/X
关于模拟器的建议
无论开发商和发行商多么不愿承认，每款电子游戏在盈利方面都有其生命周期：要么想买这款游戏的人都已经买了，要么新版本更优秀。无论哪种情况，除了游戏收藏家等边缘例子之外，发行商和开发商收获新销量的机会微乎其微。当那个时候到来时，这款电子游戏应该进入公共领域，可以被模拟，或者进入类似 GOG（前身为 Good Old Games）的平台。对于模拟，应该有一个受支持且安全的游戏模拟器供公众使用。
这主要适用于不像持续运营游戏一样有内容更新的单机游戏。对于持续运营游戏和多人游戏，这条规则只在游戏已停服且不再得到开发商和发行商支持后才适用。
你可能会好奇游戏生命周期多长才算是安全期限。在我看来，最短是发售 5 年后，最长 10 年。话虽如此，我知道会有评论试图挑出漏洞，所以我想先回应一些常见问题。
“你只是想免费玩电子游戏”
……是的，你说得完全正确。学习游戏设计的一部分就是要能玩到电子游戏，就像学习电影的人必须看电影一样。电子游戏在这方面的独特之处在于交互性：仅仅通过观看视频是无法全面审视游戏设计的。UI/UX 方面的部分问题，从一个试玩视频中无法看到。这就是为什么在我的“游戏设计深度剖析”（Game Design Deep Dive）系列中，我会尽可能多地玩各种游戏作为示例。
电子游戏目前是唯一一个仍然需要让人费尽周折才能接触到较早作品的媒介。这个问题在每年、每个新平台上都在加剧，而且只会越来越糟。10 年前的主机和游戏如此难以找到和体验，而我可以观看 50 多年前的电影，这是没有理由的。随着游戏设计对学习的需求越来越重，并且我希望更多学校能开设相关课程，如果一款游戏无法在 PC 上合法地以数字形式获取，那么人们学习的难度将会更大。
尼亚加拉学院（Niagara College）游戏设计专业/图片：尼亚加拉学院
“这会伤害开发者”
再次强调，我所说的这些游戏，是指已经过了其零售生命周期的游戏。在你看来 5 到 10 年可能很短或很长，但游戏市场的运转速度比人们愿意承认的要快。我确信有人会辩称，在 20 到 30 年前，由于发行的游戏数量稀少，一款游戏在其生命周期之后仍然可能有销量。然而，现在的市场已经不同了：每周至少有 20 到 30 款游戏发布，消费者可以轻松访问多个拥有各自商店的游戏平台。
我不想说得这么直接，但我不相信在今天的市场上，有游戏在 10 年后还能获得收入。持续运营游戏是例外，但至少在停服前，它们不在讨论范围之内。而且令人遗憾的是，对于许多游戏来说，其开发工作室到时可能已经不复存在，那之后所产生的销售额也不会直接给他们。
“盗版者会受益”
厂商总喜欢以“防盗版”当由做出各种限制，但最后被这些措施折磨的，往往是消费者而非盗版者。我的提议不会让盗版者受益，也不会助长盗版。再次强调，我所说的这些游戏已经过了其生命周期，盗版者真正感兴趣的只是最新游戏。如果有人愿意打持久战，为了免费获得你的游戏等上 10 年，那他们从一开始就不会买你的游戏。
“如果主机/版权持有者想再次销售呢？”
简单的回答是不要这样。在我看来，这是最恶劣的做法之一，而任天堂已经一次又一次地这样做。发布一款 10 年前的游戏，没有任何新增内容，却要卖到接近当今新游戏的价格，这说不过去。而像马力欧合集那样限时销售，在我看来简直是反消费者。同样，要求玩家重复购买旧商店已有的数字游戏，或者干脆不再上架，也同样糟糕。
有些公司喜欢将商店与其平台绑定，因为这样它们可以对同一款游戏进行二次、三次甚至四次收费。再说一次，这些游戏无论质量多高、获奖多少，都有其生命周期。即便如此，仅仅是把游戏拿到新平台上重新销售，意味着当那个新平台下线时，同样的问题又会重演。大多数购买重新上架的旧游戏的玩家，只是为了能继续玩他们以前买过的游戏。
如果像《生化危机 2》（Resident Evil 2）和《生化危机 3》（Resident Evil 3）那样重制游戏，将其提升到现代标准，那是另一回事。老实说，我能立刻想到几十款游戏，如果它们能方便地购买到，我会重新买，但它们并没有上架。而这也是问题的一部分，有太多游戏根本无从获取：没有现代主机版本，没有数字版，被锁定在原始平台上。
《生化危机 2》重制版，将老游戏提升到当代标准的范例/图片：PC Gamer
保存艺术
许多开发者喜欢标榜游戏产业的艺术性，如果电子游戏是艺术（它们确实是），那么是时候把它们当作艺术品来对待了。这个产业在 40 年间快速发展，但在匆忙之中，游戏产业并没有真正尝试过保存。你不能一边谴责模拟和保存，一边又说电子游戏是一种艺术媒介。
原文链接： https://medium.com/super-jump/why-video-game-preservation-needs-to-become-the-standard-b34ec6f14e0
*本文内容系作者独立观点，不代表 indienova 立场。未经授权允许，请勿转载。

title: Pimax says 'I'll have what Valve's having' as it announces new wireless VR headset, foveated streaming, updated controllers, and long Steam Machine
text:
Known for its many variants of VR headset, Pimax is back with yet more new products. This time, it seems to be following Valve's recent example, with a wireless VR headset, foveated streaming, ringfree VR controllers, and a very long Steam Machine.
Let's start with the VR headset, as Pimax isn't playing around when it comes to wireless capabilities on this thing. It's called the Crystal Pro, and it's totally wireless. Included in the box is a Wi-Fi 6E adapter, much like the Steam Frame , which hooks it up to a nearby gaming PC; however, Pimax is going one step further with an optional wireless streaming kit, 60G AirLink, that uses 60 GHz 2x2 MIMO for a higher-bandwidth, more robust connection.
"What if you could cut the cable and still send the image with no visual compression. That question is the reason this headset exists," Jaap Grolleman says in a prerecorded launch video .
Using two additional room antennas and two additional headset antennas, which poke out from the rear of the strap, Pimax is able to deliver up to 6 Gbps bandwidth—3 Gbps over each connection and each data stream sync'd up via the onboard Qualcomm Snapdragon XR2 SoC.
Pimax says 60G AirLink adds much less latency than standard Wi-Fi streaming—1.8 ms to 12 ms by its own presentation—and it uses this technology to offer something called Native Foveated Streaming.
Sound familiar? Valve introduced foveated streaming with the Steam Frame as a way to save on bandwidth for virtual reality using eye tracking. The Frame only streams a frame in high resolution where a user is looking; everywhere outside of that focus area is streamed at a lower resolution. It works great, in my experience, as unlike foveated rendering, I've not been able to notice any sign of foveated streaming in action.
Pimax is using its Native Foveated Rendering in much the same way, tapping the onboard 120 Hz Omnivision eye tracking. The focus area in the Crystal Pro is actually streamed at native resolution. It's full quality—straight from your frame buffer. Further out from the focus area, the detail diminishes until the outer edges, where it's much lower quality. You shouldn't be able to perceive that lower detail, providing everything works as intended.
Pimax Pimax Pimax Pimax Pimax Pimax As for the headset, it uses twin QLEDs running at a resolution of 2880 x 2880 each and up to 120 Hz. It taps Mini-LED for the backlight, with 576 local dimming zones per eye, and 200 nits of brightness. I was only a little disappointed not to see Micro-OLED again here, but I suppose the Dream Air and Crystal Super are already offering that for a hefty sum.
Speaking of sums, the Crystal Pro does make the Steam Frame look affordable. It costs $1,399 for the base model, or $1,899 with the 60G AirLink system. That alone costs $599.
What's surprising for the Crystal Pro is that it uses aspheric glass lenses. Those require more room in the front of the headset than pancake lenses, which are in the Dream Air, Steam Frame, and Quest 3, but Pimax says they're better suited for eye tracking.
(Image credit: Pimax) The Crystal Pro comes with SLAM 2.0 inside-out tracking, which is perhaps the most exciting thing here, in combination with the new ringless controllers. During my recent testing of the Dream Air, I found the inside-out tracking left me wanting more, and the old school halo'd controllers were a little wobbly at times. SLAM 2.0 combines four cameras, a motion sensor, and infrared illuminators for low-light tracking, which I'm hoping will help bring this in line with the Steam Frame's top-tier tracking.
Pimax Pimax Pimax Pimax Pimax Pimax The new ringless VR controllers take a leaf from the Steam Frame. They have dual triggers on both sides, TMR sticks, grip sensing, and the full complement of face buttons, which, much like the Frame, means they can be combined into one regular controller's worth of inputs.
Pimax is once again trying to do one better here, with a central module that sits in between the left and right-side pads to turn them into an actual controller. A neat idea, even if I can't see myself using it much in practice.
Pimax Pimax Pimax Pimax The Crystal Pro also shares another similarity with the Frame. It has swappable faceplates, adding full-colour passthrough and LiDAR, or Lighthouse support for outside-in tracking. It also has optional over-ear speakers that Pimax has rolled out before, but definitely take inspiration from the Valve Index.
Pimax Pimax Pimax Pimax Pimax Pimax To top it all off, Pimax is bringing out a gaming PC called the Pimax Spation, which looks oddly familiar. It's more or less a long Steam Machine .
If any of these have caught your eye, you'll have to wait a while longer before you can get your hands on them. There are no on-sale dates offered as of yet.

title: All hail the long steam machine, Pimax's new SteamOS-ready mini PC
text:
You could say Pimax is copying Valve's homework with its new mini PC, the Spation. Though the Steam Machine is merely a black box, so you could say it also copied any number of other miscellaneous black rectangles itself; the Xbox Series X among them. Nevertheless, this is one similar-looking living room machine, and Pimax is even pitching it with SteamOS.
Pimax's machine is a mini PC with a whole bunch of power behind it. Pimax says it comes with either an RX 9070 XT or RTX 5070 Ti , and a Ryzen 7 9800X3D .
It packs in 32 GB of DDR5, a 1 TB SSD, and a 1000 W SFX PSU. It also supports Wi-Fi 7, Bluetooth 5.4, and comes with 2x DisplayPort 2.1, 1x HDMI 2.1, 1x USB4, and 6x USB 3.2 Gen 2 ports.
So, it's much more capable than Valve's li'l box, though I shudder at the thought of the price. Pimax has not yet announced a price or launch date.
You can see how it all slots together under the removable rear panel in the render provided by Pimax below.
(Image credit: Pimax) Most of the I/O is accessible at the back of the device. Slightly above and behind that is what looks to be a Mini-ITX motherboard with two DIMMs installed, presumably with some sort of solution to shift the rear I/O. Above that, the power supply, with a fan mounted above it. The GPU sits flat on the reverse of the unit, using a PCIe riser cable.
My only concern is how well that graphics card can breathe in there, and more broadly for temps, but there may be yet more fans within the unit. The front panel looks to be removeable—just like the Steam Machine—with some venting in there for the GPU.
Pimax Pimax Pimax Pimax It looks like a pretty smart layout, and not totally dissimilar to a Fractal Terra —the case I use for my own mini PC—sat upright. Pimax plans to offer a barebones kit that will require a user to install their own GPU, storage, and memory, which means at least parts of it are set to be pretty standardised.
The idea behind the Spation is to be more powerful than a gaming laptop to power high-end PC VR, in a smaller size than your average PC. Thereby easier to shift besides your TV unit for a spot of virtual reality in the evening. There is a bit of a gap in the market for this sorta thing—beyond simply building your own Mini-ITX gaming PC—as the real Steam Machine has been known to struggle with VR due to its Arch-based SteamOS.
Though that might also be the case for the Spation. Pimax is pitching it with both Windows and SteamOS support. It is just a regular PC, after all, so there's nothing stopping you from loading SteamOS onto anything with compatible hardware—namely AMD's gear, as Nvidia GPU support is an ongoing process in SteamOS. Which you choose should probably depend on whether you are planning to use it for VR or not. Even though the Steam Frame has shown what Linux can do in VR, and Pimax says it's bringing Pimax Play to Linux as a dedicated client, it does feel like Windows remains the easiest option.

title: As it lays off developers and closes studios, Xbox launches a new division focused on 'how people experience our franchises beyond the games themselves'
text:
More big news out of Xbox today: A new division called Xbox XP will take the lead on "film and television, consumer products, strategic partnerships, and live experiences."
As detailed on today's announcement , here's what that breaks down to:
XBOX PICTURES : Bringing our worlds and characters to new audiences through film, television, and other forms of linear storytelling.
XBOX PRODUCTS : Creating products that are authentic to the fandom that allow fans to celebrate and express the franchises they love.
XBOX PLACES : Bringing communities together through live events, immersive experiences, attractions, broadcasts, and destinations.
XBOX PARTNERSHIPS : Working with creators, brands, and communities to develop new experiences, sponsorships, and brand partnerships.
Xbox XP will be headed by Kayleen Walters, who previously spent a couple years as president of Minecraft studio Mojang and before that spent close to a decade in different brand and "franchise development" roles at Microsoft. Prior to that she spent 13 years at Lucasfilm, finishing her time there as vice president of franchise marketing and integrated planning.
"XP is a play on 'experience points'," Xbox CEO Asha Sharma explained in a separate message , "and formalizes four investment areas for us: Xbox Pictures for film and television adaptations; Xbox Products for licensing and merchandise; Xbox Partnerships for sponsors and brand partners; and Xbox Places for our marquee broadcast and in-person events, theme parks, and other location-based experiences.
"Our franchises can mean more to people than the time they spend playing them, and Kayleen knows how to build those experiences with the industry without losing what made people care about the franchise in the first place."
(Image credit: Asha Sharma (Twitter)) A Minecraft Movie was a massive hit and I have no doubt the sequel will be too, and it's understandable that Microsoft would want a bigger piece of that action—and to leverage it across other brands too, although how many of them have that same potential is a big question.
But coming while Xbox is in the midst of laying off thousands of people who make the actual games that serve as the foundation of these franchises? The business behind Xbox XP may be solid, but it's not a great look.

FOV 90
(Image credit: Future) Welcome to FOV 90, an FPS column from staff writer Morgan Park. Every other week, I cover topics relevant to first-person shooter enjoyers, spanning everything from multiplayer and singleplayer to the old and the new.
Welcome back to another special community tournament edition of FOV 90, the only FPS column that I'm aware of.
Last week, we started the work of determining the greatest FPS mode of all time through spirited democracy . In Round 1, 16 classic and modern modes were pitted against each other in 1v1 matchups. The seeding, which I chose myself, was completely uncontroversial and everyone liked it—especially the part where I made them choose between Conquest and Domination.
Over 7,000 votes were tallied over five days, and the results are in.

title: Amazon is roasting users with their own shopping habits, but it don't have nothin' on us
text:
If you've got an Amazon account, then you likely already realise Jeff Bezos' corporate empire is hoovering up your data so it can better sell to you. What's surprising is when Amazon actually offers a peek behind that vast curtain of data, revealing what it's learnt about you and potentially reading you for filth in the process.
Amazon's 'About You' feature rolled out back in May. It gained more attention this week after one Threads user's viral post appeared to show that, based on her 'Product Preferences,' Amazon thought she had "flat buttocks." They weren't the only ones left "literally speechless," as another user shared that Amazon had noted they do " not trust people easily ." A Reddit user posted that Amazon had noted they apparently get " a tired gray cast from lack of sleep ".
Obviously, I had to take a look at whatever strays I was catching from the About You feature myself. Alas, my About You is frightfully boring and served only to remind my lactose-intolerant self that I prefer 'plant-based milk' and that I 'systematically [replace] consumable household items' like my preferred brand of milk that doesn't make my tummy hurt. So, I opened up the question to the wider PC Gamer team.
To check out your own About You on desktop, you'll need to hover over 'Hello, [your name]' on Amazon, select 'Account' from the menu, then navigate to 'Ordering and shopping preferences,' click 'Your Shopping preferences,' and then look under 'Manage your information'. It's a little easier on mobile, where you just need to tap the menu icon in the bottom bar, then tap 'Account,' then 'Shopping preferences,' and finally 'About you.'
News writer Josh quipped that "Amazon says I'm a brain jenious," before sharing that his About You notes that he "favors classic and intellectual literature," "reads extensively across literary genres," and that he "strategically purchases books during major sales." So far, so flattering, though the feature also claims that he apparently "goes camping occasionally" though Wolens says, "The last time I went camping I was 11."

My fellow hardware writer Andy is described as "probably has microwave ovens" in his About You. When the team queried the plural, Andy explained that was likely because he'd bought two from Amazon in the past, as "the first one blew up while making popcorn." Still, About You could only determine Andy 'probably' has a microwave.

title: I have added roving bands of militant furries to Grand Theft Auto 5
text:
Los Santos Customs
I'm modding GTA 5 every day in a quest to either transform it into a PC version of GTA 6 or break it entirely. Come back tomorrow to find out what new horrible thing I've done to Rockstar's baby, or check out what I got up to earlier .
Let's get one thing out of the way: I think we, as a society, as a people, are generally fine with furries at this point. The phenomenon of ragging on furry subculture has been, gladly, consigned to the dustbin of history. It's a 2010 disease from which we have convalesced. Let nothing I write from here on be taken as a slight against them.
That being said, it is very funny to give someone in a fursuit a gun and a military objective.
I have installed, well, two mods actually. The first, preliminary mod is Gang and Turf Mod , which adds a sort of gang war system in the vein of GTA: San Andreas. Different factions will wage war over areas of Los Santos, from the heart of downtown up to the podunk rural hamlets in the north.
Then I installed the main course: Furry Gang for Gang and Turf Mod , which festoons the city streets with murderers in wolf outfits who are here to take their corners with blood and gunpowder. There are other gangs—gangs installed by default with the base mod—but I honestly didn't pay much attention to them. Some of them were in suits? They truly all got steamrolled by the marauding bands of fursuited raiders.
Like an embedded reporter in a war, I followed one band of armed furries into battle. Dodging cars, they dispatched most of their foes pretty quickly, but then a tornado manifested and started whipping them into the sky. At one point, I punched one of them, mostly out of overstimulation. Then I got eaten by the tornado too. Then I teleported somewhere else. Nearby, on a ridge, was a single furry in a purple suit, immobile and gazing, planning some future conquest.
(Image credit: Rockstar) All of these things happened.

title: Subnautica 2 fans can finally hunt and kill those pesky Nibbler Mangos—in Dave the Diver's crossover DLC
text:
It took a while but there's finally an official way to hunt and kill some of Subnautica 2's most annoying sea creatures. The only catch is, you'll have to do it in Dave the Diver DLC—though as catches go, that's a pretty fun one.
The crossover was announced today at the Triple-I Initiative showcase. Coming in early 2027, the Dave the Diver X Subnautica 2 content pack will suck Dave into the alien waters of Unknown Worlds' survival game where he can mine resources, hunt fish, and—one would hope—discover some tasty new sushi recipes for Bancho to cook up. Here's the trailer:
What caught my eye even more than the glimpse of a massive and intimidating boss at the end of the trailer were those pesky Nibbler Mangos, which start biting you the second you dive into Subnautica 2 and never really stop. Players having no way to kill large enemies in Subnautica 2 has been a bit of a controversy , with some even resorting to mods so they can fight back.
It's nice that players can finally get a bit of revenge against those relentless fish, albeit in another game.
"We're thrilled to see Subnautica 2's creatures, including the Nibbler Mango, join Dave's world," Mintrocket told PC Gamer via email. "The team had a lot of fun bringing these creatures into our game, and players can expect the DLC to play just like the Dave the Diver they know and love."
As for those saddened to hear this is the final DLC for Dave the Diver, that doesn't necessarily mean it's the definitive end of his adventures.
"While this will be the final major DLC for Dave the Diver, there may still be smaller content updates or collaborations based on player feedback and our internal plans," Mintrocket told PC Gamer. "Since we're not moving straight into a sequel, we'll keep thinking about ways to make sure players don't forget Dave and his friends." Bancho the Chef, meanwhile, is getting his own game , a prequel, though a release date has yet to be announced.

title: A great indie studio is making a sequel to one of my favorite adventures 17 years later, for one simple reason: 'We're not getting any younger, and the world seems to be ending'
text:
I just made a noise like air being slowly released from a balloon .
It's been 17 years since the original Machinarium , a wordless tale of love in a crumbling city of robots. Amanita Design has put out some great games over that span— Botanicula , Chuchel , Creaks , Phonopolis —but hasn't breathed even a hint that more Machinarium might be on the way. So why now?
"We're not getting any younger, and the world seems to be ending, so if we were ever going to make Machinarium 2, now is the right time," Amanita CEO and designer Jakub Dvorský said—a bit dark, sure, but I can't find any factual fault in his reasoning. "We're also grateful to every player who waited patiently all these years. We couldn't have done it without them."
The new game picks up where Machinarium left off: Having escaped the city, Josef and Berta crash-land in a hidden valley populated by two robot tribes, one in the Elektrona monastery and the other in the city of Oilton—both of them facing a grim future as their power is slowly running out. While Machinarium 2 promises the same style of point-and-click puzzling as the original, Josef and Berta are both playable this time around, swappable at will, and will have to work together to solve the game's puzzles.
The distinctive visual style of Machinarium is back—perhaps a little sharper than the first game, although I think it still looks great—and importantly, so is Tomáš Dvořák, aka Floex, the composer whose soundtrack helped make Machinarium so distinctive and memorable.
As PC Gamer's Evan Lahti explained some years ago, music is one of the best parts of Amanita games , and Dvořák is responsible for much of it. Given his many years of collaborating with the studio on most of its games, it's not really surprising that he's back for Machinarium 2, but it is reassuring to have it confirmed.
"When I composed the first Machinarium soundtrack years ago, I never anticipated such a huge response," Dvořák told me. "I was simply trying to have fun and enjoy the creative process—and I believe that is the exact same approach I need for the sequel.
"Naturally, it’s a challenging task. It is easy to fall into the trap of comparing my new work to the original, and doubts occasionally creep in about whether it will be as engaging. However, I try to minimize those thoughts. Experience has taught me that the best way to create is to simply 'have fun'."
Interestingly, Dvořák said he didn't really think about Machinarium 2 as a sequel at all: Instead, it's more "a beautiful project [that] provides a great opportunity to create a specific kind of music ... the visuals have an incredible influence on the music universe I create. Machinarium is exactly the kind of environment where things grow very naturally for me."
The music in the Machinarium 2 trailer certainly has a familiar vibe, but Dvořák said he set a few specific goals for himself to differentiate it from the original: The soundtrack to be "more melodic and musical," something he aims to achieve with "more simplicity, which is actually the hardest part: Usually, unique organic details come from layering many sounds together."
And of course, the passage of time is a factor too: "I feel the new music is more mature," Dvořák said, "simply because I am older."
Aren't we all? Still great music, though.
As for the real reason Amanita Design opted to go back to Machinarium now, all these years later, it really was just a vibe situation. "I tend to make these kinds of decisions more intuitively than rationally. That’s just how I work," Dvorský, Amanita's CEO, told me in a separate chat.
"I guess I rely on some kind of instinct or feeling, so it’s actually quite hard for me to give you a clear, logical answer. I just had this feeling that the world of the robots was knocking on the door, asking to come out again. It seemed like a good idea, and little by little, I got really excited about it."
Amanita Design Amanita Design Amanita Design Amanita Design Amanita Design It's probably self-evident at this point, but I'm really excited about it too. Machinarium was Amanita Design's first full-length, standalone game, and it made me an immediate fan of the studio. Amanita's subsequent games have more than lived up to the high standard it set, but even so there's always been a very faint 'wish it was Machinarium' hanging in the background over every new release. Well, here we are—I guess now I can start quietly pining for Botanicula 2.
Machinarium 2 doesn't have a release date at this point, but it's up for wishlisting on Steam and GOG . For now, you can pick up Amanita's previous releases —including the original Machinarium—at some pretty sweet prices until October 15.
